theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_phdisk_mobius_ratio_norm
theorems.statement: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (z v : ℂ), a * d - b * c = 1 → 0 < z.im → 0 < v.im → let M : ℂ → ℂ := fun x => ((a : ℂ) * x + (b : ℂ)) / ((c : ℂ) * x + (d : ℂ)); ‖(M z - M v) / (M z - star (M v))‖ = ‖(z - v) / (z - star v)‖
